-- @many
-- @batch parent.id=customerId
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT customer_id AS "customerId", id, label, quantity,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY id) AS position
  FROM customer_items
  WHERE customer_id = ANY($1::int[])
    AND tenant_id = $2::text
)
SELECT "customerId", id, label, quantity
FROM ranked
WHERE position <= $3::int
ORDER BY "customerId", id

-- @many
-- @connection id
-- @batch parent.id=customerId
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT customer_id AS "customerId", id, label, quantity,
         row_number() OVER (
           PARTITION BY customer_id
           ORDER BY CASE WHEN $1::boolean THEN id END DESC,
                    CASE WHEN NOT $1::boolean THEN id END ASC
         ) AS position
  FROM customer_items
  WHERE customer_id = ANY($2::int[])
    AND tenant_id = $3::text
    AND ($4::int IS NULL OR id > $4::int)
    AND ($5::int IS NULL OR id < $5::int)
)
SELECT "customerId", id, label, quantity
FROM ranked
WHERE position <= $6::int
ORDER BY "customerId", position

-- @one
SELECT $1::bigint AS big,
       $2::real AS real,
       $3::double precision AS double,
       $4::bigint[] AS bigs,
       $5::real[] AS reals,
       $6::double precision[] AS doubles,
       NULL::bigint AS "optionalBig",
       NULL::real AS "optionalReal",
       NULL::double precision AS "optionalDouble",
       CASE $7::text
         WHEN 'nan' THEN 'NaN'::double precision
         WHEN 'infinity' THEN 'Infinity'::double precision
         WHEN '-infinity' THEN '-Infinity'::double precision
         ELSE 0::double precision
       END AS special
